items.title: The Token HUD's Vigor (red) and Resolve (blue) boxes, stacked
items.do: Right-click Orc Warrior's token (the system's HUD bar open at the bottom of the screen). In the red Vigor box type -5 and Enter; then +2; in the blue Resolve box type 3.
items.expect: The two boxes are stacked under the token (Vigor, then Resolve), both whole and both clickable, nothing over them. -5 deals 5 to Vigor only, +2 heals 2 of it, a plain number sets what is left of that pool (Resolve 3).

items.title: A condition's number: larger on the token, readable beside the chat
items.do: On Aveline's turn, Demoralize Orc Warrior (GM Force Tier 2: Vulnerable 1); give it Slowed 2 from the palette (then raise it to 3). Look at its token at your usual zoom; select it and look at the effects beside the chat, then the HUD's conditions row.
items.expect: On the token, each valued icon carries its number in a large dark disc with a gold ring covering most of the icon's lower right: readable at a normal zoom. Beside the chat, each icon is the plain icon with a large white number on a dark disc at its lower right corner. In the HUD's row the number is bold after the icon.
